description: Per-scenario regression thresholds used by scripts/dev/perf-compare.py. See docs/plans/shipped/pillar-1-2-perf-review-system.md § D2 for rationale. mean_abs_ceiling_ms (Pillar 1 absolute mean budget on avgPerCallMs, target 6.94 = 1000/144) ARMED 2026-07-06 by the perf-gate step-5 calibration pass (docs/plans/shipped/perf-gate-step5-calibration.md): the observed ci-windows-latest distribution (docs/perf/calibration-observations.md, 6 green Perf PR-fast runs) had zero scopes above ~0.72 ms avgPerCallMs — 9.6x under budget — so it arms at the raw 6.94 with an EMPTY perScenario map (no legitimately-heavy scope exists). Baselines were recaptured (#1659) so rows carry p99Ms first. mean_min_abs_delta_ms is the noise floor for the relative lastTotalMs gate: a relative regression only fires when the absolute delta also exceeds it — calibrated 2026-06-07 from the first armed CI run, where ai_chat.history.render_turn flagged +12.0% on 0.023 -> 0.026 ms (3 µs of single-frame sampling noise); 0.05 ms = 0.7% of the 6.94 ms frame budget.

perScenario.comment: Override the default for a specific scenarioId. Empty means inherit default. Tune ONLY when a real-world signal (CI false-positives, scenario noise) justifies it; document the rationale in the override entry. (2026-06-18: the cell-edit-burst p99_abs_ceiling_ms=15.0 override was REMOVED — its ~10.9 ms p99 was cold-start/warmup pollution, not a real edit-storm cost. cell-edit-burst was a 1-frame burst whose sample ring held only bootstrap frames; the p99-gate-warmup-frame-exclusion fix (#1385) gives it a steady-state window where SmatchetUI::Draw p99 is ~0.3 ms, so it now clears the global 10.0 ms floor and the override would only mask a real future regression. Resolves the verify-on-real-HW question in docs/plans/deferred/cell-edit-burst-p99-verify.md / Issue #973.)
